name: dsh-whale-commands
description: Slash commands for the DeepSeek Harness Weixin channel: persona toggle & multi-persona library, session history (soft load or real session switch), model selection, token usage and balance, scheduled daily greetings. Host-side execution, zero model tokens, hot-reload. Also ships compatibility notes and patches that let 0.1-era channel plugins run on harness 0.2.
author: spinoi-code
